title: WebAuthn passkey implementation is production-quality
description: src/webauthn.rs. The implementation covers registration, authentication, and credential counter updates (preventing replay). Challenge state is stored in the DB with TTL-based expiry. One-time passkey tokens use constant-time comparison (subtle::ConstantTimeEq) and are consumed after single use. The token store is in-memory (acceptable for 2-min TTL). Admin password is required for registration (prevents unauthorized passkey enrollment). Tests cover the security-critical paths: token consumption, expiry, rejection of invalid tokens.
